projectState.summary: Byte 13b-a is approved, merged into `main`, and the Claude review artifact has been cherry-picked. It adds a dependency-free local SQLite shell via Node's `node:sqlite`: `server/persistence.mjs` owns schema initialization plus append/read/dump helpers, `scripts/grow-db.mjs` exposes init/dump/smoke commands, and package scripts `db:init`, `db:dump`, and `db:smoke` exercise the shell. The review fix added SQLite sidecar ignores for `.sqlite`/`.sqlite3` WAL files and a Node `>=25.0.0` engine floor. Byte 13b-b is the next clean slice: wire only low-frequency decision records (`session.started`, `session.mode_changed`, `song.changed`, `timing.feel_changed`) through a buffered off-audio-path writer; hold `musical.event_recorded` for a separate high-frequency scheduler-safe slice.
